gloss: thin round slicing; cutting into thin rounds

definitions.gloss: thin round slicing; cutting into thin rounds; cross-cutting into thin circles
definitions.explanation: A cooking technique of cutting cylindrical vegetables (like green onions, cucumbers, or carrots) crosswise into thin round slices. One of the basic Japanese cutting techniques.

examples.japanese: ネギ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{小口切|こぐちぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To slice green onions into thin rounds.

examples.japanese: きゅうり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{小口切|こぐちぎ}りにして⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふる。
examples.english: Slice the cucumber into thin rounds and sprinkle with salt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ネギ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小口切|こぐちぎ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散|ち}らす→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧。
examples.english: Scatter thinly sliced green onion rounds over the miso soup as a finishing touch.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{小口|こぐち}→小口：23841_koguchi⟧ (small edge/end face) + {切|ぎ}り (cutting). Refers specifically to cutting from the end of a cylindrical vegetable, producing thin circular slices. A fundamental technique in Japanese cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小口切|こぐちぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cut into thin rounds
- ネギ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小口切|こぐちぎ}り: thinly sliced green onion
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧{小口切|こぐちぎ}り: thin round slices

OTHER JAPANESE CUTTING TECHNIQUES:
- ⟦{千切|せんぎ}り→千切り：07473_sengiri⟧: julienne — cutting into thin matchstick strips
- ⟦{乱切|らんぎ}り→乱切り：08067_rangiri⟧: rolling cut — cutting at irregular angles for even cooking
- ⟦{輪切|わぎ}り→輪切り：07474_wagiri⟧: round slicing — similar to {小口切|こぐちぎ}り but thicker slices
- ⟦{斜|なな}め{切|ぎ}り→斜め切り：08090_nanamegiri⟧: diagonal cut — slicing at an angle
- ⟦みじん{切|ぎ}り→みじん切り：07472_mijingiri⟧: mincing — cutting into very fine pieces
